args.body: Problem with the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14. A catalog check shows 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222) also got the 3% increase. These were meant to be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, a total overcharge of 4,128.60. I haven't changed anything yet. The query didn't return the original prices, so I can't confirm them. I propose reverting the 22 prices to their pre-10-14 values, once you confirm or give me the original prices. The affected orders will need correction or credit, and customers may need to be contacted by the people who own those accounts. Please confirm the revert.
